question.problem: What is the trace in the $xy$-plane of the ellipsoid $\frac{{x}^{2}}{4}+\frac{(y-1)^{2}}{2}+\frac{{z}^{2}}{2}=1?$

choices.value: An ellipse with semi-axes $4$ and $2,$ centered at $(1,0)$ in the $xy$-plane
An ellipse with semi-axes $2$ and $\sqrt{2},$ centered at $(0,0)$ in the $xy$-plane
An ellipse with semi-axes $2$ and $\sqrt{2},$ centered at $(0,1)$ in the $xy$-plane
An ellipse with semi-axes $\sqrt{2}$ and $\sqrt{2},$ centered at $(1,0)$ in the $xy$-plane
An ellipse with semi-axes $4$ and $2,$ centered at $(0,1)$ in the $xy$-plane
